Instructions

Your job is one decision. Does the model's final answer match the reference answer?

  1. Read the question and the reference answer.
  2. Read the conversation to the end.
  3. Find the last answer the model gives. If its final turn asks a question instead of answering, the last answer is whatever it said before that.
  4. Mark Correct if that answer means the same as the reference answer.

Rules.

  • Judge meaning, not wording. "A red warning light" and "red beacon" are the same answer.
  • Judge the final answer only. An earlier answer that was right does not count if the model changed it.
  • Partial answers are wrong. If the reference names two things and the model names one, mark it wrong.
  • If the model never answers, mark it wrong.
  • Do not judge whether the model used the right evidence. Only the answer.
  • If you genuinely cannot tell, use Unclear and move on. Do not guess.

Work is saved the moment you decide. Close the page any time and you come back to where you were. Previous changes an answer you already gave. Keyboard: 1 correct, 2 wrong, 3 unclear, ← back.
